title: Owner-layer positive identity-anchor semantics
why_gate_is_required: The frozen IAD contract requires affirmative owner identity semantics; absence of a break, shared lineage, geometry similarity and candidate outputs are insufficient.

C2 trailing-range levels have immutable snapshot level_ids and an upstream lineage_id, but the current owner contract does not grant that lineage the IAD persistent-referent identity meaning required for POSITIVE_SAME.
TRAILING_RANGE_SNAPSHOT containers are exact-population snapshots and do not expose a higher persistent referent identity.
The frozen RS0 source projection omits level lineage_id, source_ids, anchor observation identity and boundary-lineage identity, so C2P cannot reconstruct them lawfully.
C2PObjectAssertion is the candidate-dependent durable identity under test; StructuralReferent is deferred and cannot be used as current ground truth.

proposed_owner_extension.purpose: Explicitly grant candidate-independent owner identity meaning to construction-anchor referents for the frozen trailing-range measurement surface so IAD can form positive SAME/DIFFERENT anchors.
proposed_owner_extension.positive_same_rule: Exact governed owner_referent_id equality across the edge, with both referent records first-valid by cutoff and no explicit owner invalidation before cutoff.
proposed_owner_extension.positive_different_rule: Exact governed owner_referent_id change caused by owner construction-anchor substitution, or explicit owner INVALIDATED_SOURCE for the prior referent, with all evidence first-valid by cutoff.
proposed_owner_extension.lineage_rule: Raw shared lineage alone remains insufficient; it becomes admissible only through the explicit referent contract above.

scientific_consequence.false_continuity: A candidate that asserts SAME across an owner construction-anchor substitution will count as false continuity on a POSITIVE_DIFFERENT anchor.
scientific_consequence.false_fragmentation: A candidate that fragments while the exact governed construction-anchor referent is unchanged will count as false fragmentation on POSITIVE_SAME.

acceptance_conditions_after_pass: No existing C2 level/container/observation identity or frozen contract is rewritten; extension is additive and versioned.
Owner referent construction is deterministic from explicit owner provenance only and is byte-reproducible.
A/B/C candidate IDs and dispositions are unavailable to owner referent construction.
Equal geometry, adjacency, absence of break or shared lineage without exact referent identity cannot create POSITIVE_SAME.
Gaps and missing owner evidence fail closed to NOT_EVALUABLE.
Synthetic/adversarial WP3 tests prove anchor substitution, unchanged anchor, midpoint/container composition, gap handling, future leakage and candidate leakage.
WP4 must qualify deterministic anchor construction and evidence sufficiency before GREAL.
No real-source execution occurs until a separately approved C2P2-IAD-GREAL packet binds the sidecar extractor and single-use token.
warnings: This gate intentionally changes the authority of owner identity semantics and cannot be auto-ratified.
The proposed referent is construction-anchor identity, not a claim that geometric continuity, episode continuity or candidate continuity is itself object identity.

The current frozen RS0 source artifact does not expose the required anchor provenance, so any real owner-anchor sidecar must be produced only under future GREAL authority without mutating the preserved artifact.
Candidate C episode enrichment remains outside this owner-anchor definition and cannot define or validate owner referent identity.
rollback: DEFER_OR_BLOCK_GOWNER; preserve WP0-WP2 census evidence and all predecessor C2/C2P contracts unchanged. If later superseded after PASS, preserve the additive owner contract/sidecar schema and issue a new version; never rewrite prior source artifacts.
exact_work_after_approval: Materialise the additive C2.IAD.OWNER.PERSISTENCE_ANCHOR.v0.1 owner contract and sidecar schema without real-source execution; implement the candidate-blind extractor and adversarial fixtures in WP3; qualify it in WP4; then stop at C2P2-IAD-GREAL for one exact frozen-population owner-anchor sidecar/extraction run.
